name: eDreams ODIGEO S.A.
summary: eDreams ODIGEO S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an online travel company in France, Southern Europe, Northern Europe, and internationally. The company offers online travel agency services under the Go Voyages, eDreams, Opodo, Travellink, and Liligo brand names. It also provides admin and IT consulting, and metasearch services. The company was formerly known as LuxGEO Parent S.a.r.l. and changed its name to eDreams ODIGEO S.A. in January 2014. eDreams ODIGEO S.A. was founded in 1999 and is based in Madrid, Spain.
